We truly appreciate you showing 5 McAllister - thank you.    *TURN KEY* - Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath home offering a smart layout, flexible living space, and an unbeatable location for today's lifestyle. With a one-car garage and a thoughtfully finished basement, this home checks all the boxes. The primary bedroom is conveniently located on the main level, offering comfort and privacy. The main floor also features bright, inviting living and dining spaces that flow seamlessly and are perfect for everyday living. Upstairs, you'll find two additional generously sized bedrooms and a full bath, ideal for family, guests, or a home office setup. The finished basement adds amazing space-perfect for a playroom, home gym, media room, or work-from-home area. Step outside to a fenced in yard designed for entertaining, whether you're hosting summer barbecues, gatherings with friends, or enjoying a quiet evening outdoors. Ideally located close to major commuter routes, train stations, shopping, dining, and all that Norwalk has to offer, this home truly delivers convenience, comfort, and versatility.
